prompt: Get-or-create without computeIfAbsent. First, if the map `m` does not contain the key cl[i], put a new ArrayDeque under that key (one if statement using containsKey with !). Second, read that deque into a new `Deque<Integer> q` using m.get(cl[i]).
answer:
if (!m.containsKey(cl[i])) m.put(cl[i], new ArrayDeque<>());
Deque<Integer> q = m.get(cl[i]);
why: The if/put/get form does the same in two steps; use containsKey then put then get.
